text.content:
Night City's AI-run cab company.

Headquarters: Delamain HQ (#38), Vista del Rey, Heywood
Industry: Autonomous taxis
In Night City: The only cab company with a Combat Zone contract the Valentinos honor
Known for: The only transport service in the city owned and run by an artificial intelligence

Delamain cabs drive themselves and are owned and run by an AI, the only such transport service in Night City. The AI is very polite and slightly strange. Its cabs go almost anywhere; past Delamain's contracts, the only cab that will enter a Combat Zone is a CombatCab.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.18; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 05, 10
